gold: Acute myocardial infarction due to critical stenosis of the proximal left anterior descending artery, presenting with de Winter ECG pattern evolving to Wellens syndrome

selector.rationale: High troponin level and ECG changes support myocardial infarction, with coronary angiography showing significant stenosis in the proximal left anterior descending artery

rejected.label: Hypertensive Heart Disease
rejected.why: Lack of significant findings supporting hypertensive heart disease as primary diagnosis

rejected.label: Coronary Artery Disease
rejected.why: While present, coronary artery disease is a broader category and myocardial infarction is a more specific diagnosis supported by the evidence
